steps.name: Star Dwarf's Request
steps.objective: After talking with [Elphie] at the entrance to “Silver Branch Mansion,” go to [Taffy] inside the mansion.

lines.speaker: 엘피
lines.text: Poot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s a strange-looking person. No… it doesn’t seem to be a person.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Eyes shine in the black darkness...)

lines.speaker: 엘피
lines.text: Hello, are you Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He nodded and introduced himself.)

lines.speaker: 엘피
lines.text: Oh... okay. He seems to be quite talented!

lines.speaker: 엘피
lines.text: Nice to meet you, my name is Elphie, and I am the gatekeeper of Silverbough Mansion!

lines.speaker: 엘피
lines.text: You could say I was lucky to have met a talented Adventurer at a time like this!

lines.speaker: 엘피
lines.text: If it's okay with you, would you like to visit my mansion and meet [Taffy], a [Star Knight]?

lines.speaker: 엘피
lines.text: I have a request that I would like to ask you.

steps.name: constellation cliff
steps.objective: After talking to [Taffy] in “Silver Branch Mansion”, defeat [Luceria] inside “Constellation Cliff”.

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Elf said that a guest came to visit.. I couldn't help but wonder what kind of person it was. (curious)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Hot! A face I see for the first time! Tapi is a little nervous! (surprise)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: But he doesn't seem like a bad person... (worried)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Anyway, I must welcome you! Tapi's warm heart hopes for a friendly relationship! (Decision)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Nice to meet you, nice to meet you~ Welcome to <Lirir>, the cradle of stars! Oh so~ (Explosive joy)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: My name is Tapi, a star knight who follows the will of the star keeper and protects Ririr! Just leave everything to me! (Confident)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Well, it's not like I don't feel like I'm in a position to be helped... (sudden thought)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s ask about the favor that Elphie mentioned….)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Oh my, Elphie is so impatient. But I trust Elphie’s eyes. They say the gatekeeper of the Silverbough Mansion is not a decoration. (trust)

lines.speaker: 가피
lines.text: How did you decide to be the gatekeeper back then?

lines.speaker: 다피
lines.text: Cockroach Poker Dapo.

lines.speaker: 나피
lines.text: Anya, I think I planted beans that day… ?

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: It's noisy! (screaming)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Ahem, let’s get back to the point. (Calm down)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Actually, there is an intruder roaming around our Lirir right now... . (nervous)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: But I can't figure out exactly where I am and what I'm doing! (indignant)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: This tapi… Tapi is... I'm embarrassed! This star dwarf is so inadequate as a star knight! (shame)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Then, I recently got a clue. I discovered an incredibly large magical force moving from the constellation cliff. (boundary)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: But when you try to get close to this place, you end up lost due to some strange magic... (discouragement)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: According to what our mysterious and wonderful wizards have investigated, there is a spell around the cliff that prevents fairies with the night spirit as their source from approaching. (embarrassing)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: In other words, we star dwarves and moon elves whose roots are the dark and moon spirits cannot approach... Doesn’t it smell like a foul pubic hair?! (anger)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: But now! A wanderer who suddenly appears! There was Adventurer with great and powerful power! (excited)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: This must be the guidance of the star keeper! (Great excitement)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Please, please take a look at what is happening at the constellation cliff! (please)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: … … intruder? You broke through my barrier?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: It's annoying. We've just entered the most important step.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: … Come out, Luceria.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can sense a dark magical energy. What looks like a girl’s shape begins to appear in the fog.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Ego, your fear, pain, fear and hatred that you have accumulated over a hundred years... All of that...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Let them pour it out!

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Ho... ? Luceria may be inexperienced, but she is Walpurgis' horse, so it's surprising that she can be defeated so easily.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Now I see they are the Adventurer people I met at my mansion? This is rude... . It was heightened. Are you at peace?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She looks vaguely familiar, but she must be the first girl I’ve seen….)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Hmm… . Don't you remember me?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Ah, you tried so hard to get rid of me, but you've already forgotten?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Have you really forgotten? I, [Pandora]... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora… She is the owner of the Poe Mansion who fought when rescuing Levi Ahrens in the Gothic Room. Her appearance has completely changed….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s ask a question….)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Oh, is it because of this appearance that I didn’t recognize you? Of course, it looked like this... . It's thanks to you guys.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You could say it was the aftermath of losing most of my strength, thanks to almost dying in the fight at Poe Mansion.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Thanks to you, I ended up with a body like this.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … … … … But somehow I feel like I should say thank you... ?

choices.text: 2. Who is the girl you just fought with?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That child is Luceria. [Luceria of Deception] She was once a promising witch.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: My friend and I tried to kill each other on friendly terms. Hehehe… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Well, actually, on my part, she was somehow obsessed with me, so I had no choice but to deal with her.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Eventually, I got tired of it, so about 100 years ago, I pulled out its soul and sealed it in a doll.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You must be having a great time right now with the thousand magical beasts sealed together in the doll.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Ho ho ho…

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Hmm… How should I explain it? Would it be okay to say that a path was created to allow the flow of powerful magic power that fills Lilir's <Sky> to flow to the center of Lilir?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Why did you do that? I can't say that. I just did what I was asked to do...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … Well, the evil deeds of Agashura you imagine... It's clear they're not the same thing.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: If you really want to know more details, how about asking the people who requested me?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: If you go to the [Star Cradle] under the land of Ririr, they will be there.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … One thing is, if I don't show you respect...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora seemed to be muttering something, but I couldn't hear it clearly...)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … … No, nothing.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: If I have nothing more to say, I'll leave. Maybe we'll meet again in the cradle of the stars.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Well then-

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora suddenly disappeared….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…Let’s tell Tapi what happened here.)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Something like that happened... . I definitely heard what happened at Constellation Cliff. I heard you right! (Thanks)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Cradle of stars... That place is the center of Liliir.

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: It is now a forbidden area strictly guarded by core keepers, but there was an intruder... ! (surprised)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Adventurer! I hope you can help me a little more!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s ask a question….)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Cradle of stars... That place was a place that only the Starkeeper could enter in the past.

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: It is said that the [Star Heart], the source of the power of the star that sleeps in Ririr, is sleeping there! (homage)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: When star dwarves grow older and reach the end of their lifespan, they return to their original form as dark spirits... (sorrow)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: However, the star knights who decided to protect Ririr can leave their thoughts in their bodies even if their life spans end! (impact)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Those beings who became like that are star keepers and core keepers. They are still wandering underground caves to protect the cradle of stars.

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: There is only one thing that remains in their minds: the mission to defeat the invaders! They cannot distinguish between friend and foe. You better be careful!

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: The entrance to the Cradle of Stars is located in the basement of Silverbough Mansion.

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Please, I would appreciate it if you could find out what's going on with the intruder there and, if possible, ask him to leave... ! (Eagerly)

steps.name: Dreaming in the cradle...
steps.objective: After talking to [Taffy] in the “Silver Branch Mansion,” defeat [Hero King Theseus] in the “Star Cradle” inside the mansion.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Were you the ones causing the commotion outside?

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: This area faces the cradle of stars, the fertile soil of the sacred sky, and the center of Ririr.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: This place where the spirit veins of heaven and earth gather as one is not a place for uninvited guests like you to visit.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: I can't pass this way!

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: My name is Theseus. Now, let the fight begin!!

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: It's been a long time since I had such a fun fight! Haha… It's delightful.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Come on, let’s make it a little more exciting! Please please me even more!

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: (I see a gap… it’s now!)

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Hmm?! Yes, you guy!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly Luzmen appeared and rushed towards the heart of the star, but Theseus blocked him...!)

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: Chiit, was I wrong?

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: This guy, you're the one giving me the unpleasant energy I was feeling earlier. It's a group of thieves seeking Changseong's power. Give up! There are no blind spots for Jim!

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: … … Sheesh… , Don’t show off, you bastard, I’ll kill you!?

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: Damn, if only this damn restraint weren't there... … Well, you shouldn't dwell on failure.

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: Hey there kids, I got here comfortably thanks to you cleaning up in front of me. thanks. Hot hot hot… !

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Rusmen is giggling and laughing…)

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: However, this does not mean that the previous debt has been paid off.

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: You'd better be careful not to lose your head when you sleep.

lines.speaker: 루즈멘
lines.text: That big guy over there, I’ll kill you too someday. Just wait and see!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Luzmen escaped the cave. His strange movements made him move at surprising speed.)

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: … Hmm, he is such a strange person, how can he give off such an evil aura?

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: By the way… I guess you didn't come here with bad intentions.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: First, let’s listen to the story. What brought you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Request received from Tapi. Talked about the conversation with Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Hmm… I see, it is not [their] intention to make the star dwarves, the inhabitants of this land, worry.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Let's go over there, they'll probably come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (them?)

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Oh my? A guest has arrived?

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Hmm? It's a face that somehow feels familiar... It's so ordinary that it feels familiar... ?

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Fairy King, did things go well?

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Oh great King of Heroes, my friend! Thank you very much, everything is going well thanks to you!

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Well, another hour... Did you say that? Witch girl?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Yes, Fairy King.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Due to the barriers created in various places, Ririr's magic passes through the Cradle of Stars and is gathered here in the [Star Heart].

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The barrier lasts for about an hour. In the meantime, you will achieve what you want.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Um… … .

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: … … … … … … … … … Umhuhuhuhuhuhuh.

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Ehehehe… . I can't stop laughing----

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Oh Titania, beautiful Titania, what a fun night♪

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Lalala, handsome Oberon. It’s a really beautiful night~♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Fairy King and his wife, strangely excited, began to dance polka.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s painful to look at the chicken meat…)

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Those of you who look like you don't have a lover, what's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I suppressed my volcano-like anger for now.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s ask a question….)

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Oh my, did I make the star dwarves worry?

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Ah, I'm sorry, really----

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: It's legitimate for us to be here. When the Starkeeper left the earthly world, he asked us to take care of Lirir from time to time.

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: The star dwarves will feel safe knowing that we are here.

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Because we were in such a hurry, we couldn't tell you the story and made many people worry... Sorry.

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: … Hehehe. Are you curious~?

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: That… I mean. Umm… ..

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Hahaha. Are you embarrassed?

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: … Actually, it happened!

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: It happened oh---!

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: After a thousand years, finally... !

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Yes, I've been waiting for it for over a thousand years... .

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: After a thousand years, there is a successor!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Well, that's really a good thing. I am so happy, Fairy King and Queen.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … Congratulations!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I said congratulations…)

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Hehehe, thank you~

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Anyway, this is why we need special [stars] for our princes and princesses.

choices.text: 3. What kind of star is about to be born now?

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: These children are born with bodies that will become the future masters of the fairy world and with great power enough to overshadow the world, but they are also destined to face the great darkness.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Therefore, ordinary blessings are not enough, as their fate may soon determine the fate of the world.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: That's why we want to give you the best blessing we can as parents... !

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: The Morning Star, which will now be born with the power gathered in the [Star Heart], will become a powerful guardian star that brightens the future of our children.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Witch, where will the Morning Star, who received the Holy Stone’s protection, be born? hmm? The change has begun!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, auspicious light began to pour from the sacred stone.)

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: … A star is finally about to be born! Where is it?

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Can you tell me where it is, witch?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … It seems to be close to the sky above the barrier stretched out on the cliff of the constellation.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: It will be good for prenatal education if you bathe in starlight with the protection of babies!

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Eh? Where did you get such a ridiculous story?

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Constellation Hill! good! Titania! Let's go!

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Ah, Oberon too... I can't stop you. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Witch. Thank you for helping me - I will definitely keep my promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora silently bowed her head in greeting.)

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Hahaha - Titania, my lover like the bright dew of dawn! Isn’t this a truly blessed day!

lines.speaker: 타이타니아
lines.text: Hohoho~ That's right, Oberon-

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Hmm, so it's very natural for stars to be born in Ririr and for stars to set.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: But there are times when you need a very special star.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: A star to shine light in dark places... A star to give warmth to life shivering in the cold... And a star to protect someone...

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Then, just like the star keeper did, come to this place, the cradle of the stars, and pray to the huge starstone you see over there. Then a star is born to make your wish come true.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: But since we are not as powerful as the Starkeepers, we gathered the magic power of Ririr into the Holy Stone with the help of the witch here.

lines.speaker: 오베론
lines.text: Hehehe… There's not much left now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The fairy king couple tap danced round and round and disappeared towards the cave entrance...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There are three people left who look like sacks of barley.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (When [Heart of the Star] loses its light at the right time, the atmosphere becomes even more empty!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Theseus cleared his throat.)

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Ahem. therefore… My name is Theseus, as I said before. He is the king of a small country.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: I'm an old friend of that fairy king and his wife... I came to this world briefly to help King Oberon.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: If you're curious about how the relationship between Jim and the Fairy King couple came about... .

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: I will talk about this later when I have time.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Anyway, it seems like my work here is done, so I guess I have to go back to my world soon.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Little witch, thank you very much for helping Jim's friends. The little girl is truly amazing!

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … As I've said several times, I'm not as young as I look... Thank you. King of Heroes.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Umm. Say hello to the fairy king and queen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As the King of Heroes made complex hand gestures, a brightly shining door appeared in the air.)

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Fighting with you was very fun. And tell the people here that I'm sorry for causing trouble.

lines.speaker: 테세우스
lines.text: Hahaha! Hello!

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I was nervous because a big guy appeared out of nowhere, but in the end, nothing happened... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The King of Heroes disappeared, and only Pandora remained.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Hmm, it's quiet now.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … Why do you look at me like that?  Do you have anything to say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s ask a question….)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Hmm? I am Pandora. The owner of the Poe Mansion. Gendia's only witch. and… As you know, it is Agash Rai.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Why are you interested in me? What more do you want to know?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Um, well… It doesn't matter though.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … Hmm, I guess you noticed a contradiction?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: What… Okay, let me tell you.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I guess I'm being too kind to the people who tried to kill me.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Hehe… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Agashura's Contract. An almighty power that makes any wish in the world come true.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Instead, those who make a wish lose something forever, and Agashura... lose one's life

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That's the rule.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: But I, who saved Levy's life, am still alive today. Isn't it strange?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Let me tell you two stories.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Poe Mansion… A long time ago, the owners of that place were the knight Edgar and the wizard Alan. They say the two were a good duo.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Of the two, wizard Alan was a smart and sincere man. In old age, I reached great heights. Enough to bend the laws of the world somewhat with mysterious magical power... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The Poe Mansion is that kind of place. It is a place that has the power to escape from the ways of the world for a moment.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: By using the power of that mansion and my secret skills as a witch, I was able to escape the laws of Agashura and survive.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: But… Things changed a while ago.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The Law of Agashura... The price it demands from Agashura is ‘sacrifice’.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Because it no longer works.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Agashura... I gained the almighty power to make my wish come true, and gained the possibility of becoming a living god on earth.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … I'm not sure why that happened... One thing is certain.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: When this change occurred... What was felt everywhere in the world was the power of that foolish, pitiful girl.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Hehehe… Well, it's a good thing for me. Thanks to you, I can now leave the mansion and do what I want.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … … … Levy? Are you curious about my relationship with Levy?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: A long time ago, a knight came to Poe Mansion.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: His name is Rhian Ahrens. Yes, it was Levy's father.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi was a newborn and was suffering from an incurable disease. If things continued as they were, death would soon be inevitable.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Rhian Ahrens risked his own life and asked me to save his son. I made that wish come true...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi Ahrens survived. Instead, I lost my ‘feelings’.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Why did Levy, rather than his father, who was the subject of the contract, have to pay the price for the contract? If you thought that way, you're mistaken.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Rhian Ahrens, he paid hellish pain for his wish. Because I lost my son's precious 'feelings', which were more precious than life... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Agashura's contract is scary because you don't know what you will have to pay in return for your wish... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: And apart from Agashura's contract, I am Lian and Levy. I came to possess the souls of two rich people at the same time...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … It's not a very warm and friendly relationship, is it? Hehehe…

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: However, by defeating me, you, the 'Irregulars' and 'Possibilities' in this world, Levy was able to gain freedom again.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: And… He's working for the royal family now. And come visit me often.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Just like I did when I was young...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Are you curious about my purpose?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The purpose... I told you, right? I only helped at the request of the Fairy King and his wife.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … Well, that's right. Surely I have my reasons.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The fairy world needs the magic power of light.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The magical power of the fairy world is fatal to the same type of power as the witch power I have.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I need that pure power that can disperse even the oldest and most dangerous magic of the abyss.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You have to have that power to make them… him… … .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Pandora!

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi Ahrens? How here?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I've been chasing the magic that connects you and me.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: As I concentrated my mind, I felt a magical energy that felt like a long skein of thread.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … Such nonsense. … You're a warrior, but you're pretending to be a high-level wizard.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … Hmm. Also Levi Ahrens. Elias You are the best knight, huh? … Okay, what's going on?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Of course, I came to take Pandora with me.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: … Aren't you unable to live outside the mansion? Everyone in the mansion is worried. Let’s go back together.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Yes? what… … .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: If you're not going, go back. I have work to do.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: That can't be possible. … I don't know what's going on, but I'll be there to help.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: No. Go back! hurry!

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Pandora... ? What's going on? Please explain.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … You're persistent, eh!

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: ?! Repatriation magic?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: … Pandora, what the hell… ?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … … … … … … … … … … … … … … Did you go back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora began muttering to herself.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … Levy, it's too dangerous for you.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I started this because I wanted to give something back to you, but it doesn't make sense to put yourself in danger, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The story of “something I want to return…” bothers me.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … Oh, I was talking… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … … In the end, what I want to find is.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That’s… Levy’s… … .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Mi, smile, sa, sa sa, sa, rang! … … Like this.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … … joy! If you want to laugh, smile. Because I'm serious.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I will definitely have to return it. Even if that… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora does not continue speaking.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … The promised night is not far away. I'm going to go. Because there’s a lot left to prepare…

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … I warn you. You guys, it's better not to get involved carelessly.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Don’t get involved in [Walpurgis Night].

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: No matter how much you are, you won't be safe if you step into the witch's festival carelessly...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Well then, bye.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora has left. Let's go to Tapi and tell her what happened except about Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: Adventurer, you are here! (expectation)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Tapi what happened in the Cradle of Stars.)

lines.speaker: 타피
lines.text: I see. I'll do the rest! (worry)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For now, is the work at the Cradle of Stars concluded like this? I think Pandora, Luzmen, and Theseus will meet again someday...)
